reviewer: Codex, feature-assisted and visual scene review, 1 November 2026; no independent human review claimed
evidence: artifacts/data_review/all_pairs_01.jpg through all_pairs_18.jpg and candidates_01.jpg; original decode and dimension audit
alignment_decision: All 890 pairs show corresponding content at contact-sheet scale; the 128-pixel phase-correlation screen has no translation flags. This is an initial alignment screen, not subpixel registration certification.
duplicate_policy: Keep the numerically lowest ID for each exact decoded-RGB duplicate input group. Preserve all source files. Different curated references do not justify repeating identical inputs.
mpo_policy: Accepted quarantine of two-frame challenging/2.png; preserve the original. Additional source-ambiguity quarantines are listed explicitly. Revised challenging count is prospective and must not be described as the complete 60-image benchmark.
scene_policy: Accepted conservative visual groups plus all frozen-descriptor raw/raw edges at cosine >=0.93. Every remaining out-of-group nearest-neighbor case was visually reviewed in focus_01 through focus_11. Ambiguous cross-set source families are quarantined; retained challenging related views share scene IDs. Disjointness is with respect to reviewed visual/source-proxy clusters, not unprovided geographic, camera or dive identifiers.
